title: Dare House releases a new original single titled " Letter"
htmlContent:
American-based artist Dare House releases a beautiful single named "Letter" it is an outstanding contemporary R&B with a mix of alternative rap that fills the room whenever it's played.

"Letter" is an exquisite song that tells a story of a Playboy that finally falls in love and tries changing his old ways because of a spectacular woman. Still, the words are too hard to voice, so he has to write her a beautiful "letter" that tells of his love. 

" letter" is a song that gives you many ways to tell you are significant other or crush how you feel. It's a lovely, upbeat, slow kind of music that brings in the feels whenever it's played with the soft yet bass-laden sound and a perfect rendition from Dare House.

Dare House is a born artist who is very talented in all genres of music and always delivers the best. He is multi-talented and plays the guitar, bass, drums, and keyboard. coming from a musically inclined family, he was always encouraged and supported in his music pursuit. Dare House is a full-time soloist and has worked with a few in the industry, like Amaarae, Thuy, and VanJess. Hearing this much about him, we had to feature him on our page.
